title: balsamorhiza deltoidea var. glabrescens
intro: Balsamorhiza deltoidea var. glabrescens, commonly known as Glabrous Balsamroot or Rocky Mountain Balsamroot, is a plant species native to North America. This plant is known for its roots and rhizomes, which contain compounds with medicinal properties. The health benefits of Glabrous Balsamroot include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
